````text
# #3909: Patch: the AI's count of next turn's damage to its hero leaves out Scorch's swings, which can never hit a hero, and lets no Taunt wall Toxopid
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The practice AI estimates how much damage the other side's board could deal to its hero next turn, and plays very defensively once that number reaches its life. Two cards fool the estimate.

Scorch is a cheap Common unit that may attack ten times a turn, but only the unit directly across from it, never a hero. The AI counts it as ten hits to the face (twenty when Radiant). So one Scorch on the other side makes an AI at 10 life believe it faces lethal: it spends cards and trades to kill Scorch and switches units to Defense for nothing. Its own Scorch makes it believe it threatens lethal when it doesn't.

Toxopid ignores Taunt, yet the AI thinks a unit in Defense Position stops it. Once this is built, the AI reads both rules as the game applies them.

## Why

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1101-1131` (`face_threat_from`) sets `may_hit_hero` to `!gauntlet || attack_restriction(state, unit, &hero).is_ok()` (line 1125). Outside The Gauntlet every swing counts as able to hit the hero, and line 1126 pushes one swing per `attacks_per_turn`.
- S+ #37 Scorch (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c037_scorch.rs`; SPEC §8: Common, cost 1, Can't Defend, Ranged, Pierce, can attack 10 times per turn, can only attack the unit directly across) carries `attacks_only_across` (R3550001). The engine refuses that flag against any hero (`crates/engine/src/restrictions.rs:236-247`).
- `damage_past_taunts` (`evaluate.rs`, around 1175-1195) binds an attacker to a Taunt by `attack_restriction` alone. Ignores Taunt is applied at the Taunt check (`crates/engine/src/combat.rs:548`, `flags_of(..).ignores_taunt`), not in `attack_restriction`. So S+ #121 Toxopid (Mythic, 10/10, Radiant 20/20, R3560007) is walled by any Taunt, including the one Defense Position grants.
- Neither `attacks_only_across` nor `ignores_taunt` appears anywhere under `crates/ai/src`.
- What it costs: `lethal_threat` is 150 and `lethal_pressure` 20 (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:705-707`). `wall_switches` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:962`) offers Defense switches whenever `face_threat` reaches the AI's life. The reply's lethal read uses the same `damage_past_taunts` (`crates/ai/src/reply.rs`).

## Proposal

- In `face_threat_from`, a unit whose `flags_of(..).attacks_only_across` is set asks `attack_restriction` about the hero, as a unit in The Gauntlet's lanes already does. The flag is read first, so a board with no such unit costs nothing more.
- In `damage_past_taunts`, an attacker whose `flags_of(..).ignores_taunt` is set is never bound by a Taunt.
- Both sit behind one new `EvalWeights` flag, on in the tiers' weights and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, as `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks` is (`config.rs:366, 567, 843`). Add a paragraph on it to `crates/ai/README.md`.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`
- A new test file under `crates/ai/tests/ai/`, modelled on `gauntlet.rs`
- SPEC §4.2; R3550001, R3560007

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An enemy Scorch with nothing across from it gives `face_threat == 0` (10 today, 20 when Radiant).
- [ ] With the AI at 10 life and Scorch the only enemy attacker, `wall_switches` offers nothing.
- [ ] An enemy Toxopid facing one Defense-Position unit gives `face_threat == 10` (0 today).
- [ ] `face_threat_with(.., &GREEDY_EVAL)` is unchanged on each of these boards.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate` pass.

## Size and risks

Hard by label (the AI), small in code: about 40 lines plus tests. It moves the learned `face_threat` feature on boards holding these two cards, as the Gauntlet fix (#3287) did, and the gate shows whether that costs anything. Left for later, since each needs a new engine board fact first: the same estimate also ignores Force Projector's and Oct's per-turn damage pool (R3550004) and Unan's lethal guard (R1204).

## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43666428851)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The AI's face-damage estimate reads two engine rules as the game applies them. A unit that "can only attack the Unit directly across" (S+ #37 Scorch, `attacks_only_across`, R3550001) never counts toward face damage. An attacker that Ignores Taunt (S+ #121 Toxopid, `ignores_taunt`, R3560007) is never bound by a Taunt, Defense Position's included. Both readings sit behind one new `EvalWeights` flag, `static_attack_flags_read`. It is on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, so the greedy yardstick is unchanged.

The acceptance numbers:
- An enemy Scorch with nothing across from it gives `face_threat == 0`. It gave 10 before, and 20 when Radiant.
- At 10 life with Scorch the only enemy attacker, `wall_switches` offers nothing.
- An enemy Toxopid facing one Defense-Position unit gives `face_threat == 10`. It gave 0 before.
- `face_threat_with(.., &GREEDY_EVAL)` is unchanged on each of these boards.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate` pass.

|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | `change`: new `pub static_attack_flags_read: bool` in `EvalWeights`, `true` in `AI_EVAL`, `false` in `GREEDY_EVAL`. The `GREEDY_EVAL` doc comment (~line 831) lists it among the flags that are off. |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | `change`: `face_threat_from` reads `attacks_only_across`. `damage_past_taunts` becomes a wrapper over a new `damage_past_taunts_with(.., w)` that skips Taunt-ignorers when binding. Doc comments updated. |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | `change`: sentences on the flag, in the paragraph that already covers `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks` and `brittle_crumbles_before_swing` (~lines 107-113). |

- SPEC §4.2 (step 3's Taunt check, which `ignores_taunt` skips) and §9.9 (the evaluation).

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `EvalWeights` struct.** After `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks` (~line 366) add:
   ```rust
   /// R3550001, R3560007, #3909: whether `face_threat` (and `damage_past_taunts_with`) read two static attack
   /// flags the engine applies outside the plain Taunt walk. A unit that can only attack the Unit directly
   /// across never may hit a hero, so `face_threat` asks `attack_restriction` of it as of a Gauntlet unit and
   /// counts none of its swings. A unit that Ignores Taunt is never bound by a Taunt, Defense Position's
   /// included. Off, both count as before.
   pub static_attack_flags_read: bool,
   ```
   Add `static_attack_flags_read: true,` to `AI_EVAL`, after `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks: true,` (~line 567). Add `static_attack_flags_read: false,` to `GREEDY_EVAL`, after `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks: false,` (~line 843). Add `static_attack_flags_read` to the flag list in `GREEDY_EVAL`'s doc comment (~line 831). These are the only two `EvalWeights` literals in `crates/` (the tests' `..AI_EVAL` updates inherit it). No JSON fixture holds the flags.

2. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `face_threat_from` (~line 1101).** `flags_of` and `attack_restriction` are already imported. Replace the `may_hit_hero` line (~1125) with:
   ```rust
   // R3550001, #3909: a unit that can only attack the Unit across never hits a hero. The flag is read first,
   // so a board with no such unit asks `attack_restriction` nothing more than before.
   let across_only = w.static_attack_flags_read && flags_of(state, unit).attacks_only_across == Some(true);
   let may_hit_hero = !(gauntlet || across_only) || attack_restriction(state, unit, &hero).is_ok();
   ```
   Keep the `for _ in 0..attacks_per_turn(...)` push as is. A false `may_hit_hero` already makes `damage_past_taunts` drop the swing past the Taunts. Change the last line of the function to `damage_past_taunts_with(state, attacker.opponent(), &attacks, w)`.

3. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `damage_past_taunts` (~line 1164).**
   - Rename the existing function `damage_past_taunts_with` and add a fourth parameter `w: &EvalWeights`. Keep the body, except the Taunt binding below.
   - Add above it a wrapper with the old signature:
     ```rust
     /// `damage_past_taunts_with` at `AI_EVAL`'s weights: the lethal solver's `ready_gap` and the tests' oracles read it.
     pub fn damage_past_taunts(state: &GameState, defender: PlayerId, attacks: &[(&CardInstance, i32, bool)]) -> i32 {
         damage_past_taunts_with(state, defender, attacks, &AI_EVAL)
     }
     ```
   - In the `partition` closure of the `while i < stands.len()` loop, change the predicate to:
     ```rust
     |(attacker, _, _)| {
         !(w.static_attack_flags_read && flags_of(state, attacker).ignores_taunt == Some(true))
             && attack_restriction(state, attacker, &target).is_ok()
     }
     ```
     A Taunt-ignorer therefore always lands in `unbound` and reaches the final loop, which adds its hit through `projected_hero_damage` when `may_hit_hero`. The flag is read first, so a board with no Taunt-ignorer costs nothing more.
   - Extend the doc comments. On `damage_past_taunts_with`: "with `w.static_attack_flags_read` an attacker that Ignores Taunt (R3560007) is bound by none". On `face_threat_with`: "…and a unit that can only attack the Unit across lands nothing on a hero (R3550001)". Cite only R-ids that have notes: R3550001, R3560007, R1849005.

4. **`crates/ai/README.md`.** After the sentence ending "(`gauntlet_bars_face_attacks`, R1849005, #3287; off in `GREEDY_EVAL`)." add: "A unit that can only attack the Unit directly across from it (S+ #37 Scorch) may hit no hero, and an attacker that Ignores Taunt (S+ #121 Toxopid) is bound by no Taunt, Defense Position's included: `face_threat` asks `attack_restriction` of the first, and `damage_past_taunts_with` leaves the second unbound (`static_attack_flags_read`, R3550001, R3560007, #3909; off in `GREEDY_EVAL`). `damage_past_taunts` itself, which the lethal solver's `ready_gap` reads, takes `AI_EVAL`'s flag, as `could_attack_next_turn` takes its Brittle flag."

5. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs`**: add `pub mod static_attack_flags;`.

6. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/static_attack_flags.rs`**: write it per **Tests** below. Header doc: "Scorch's swings and Toxopid's Ignores Taunt in the AI's threat (#3909, R3550001, R3560007)". Imports exactly as `gauntlet.rs` does (`use jackioh_ai::*; use jackioh_engine::testkit::*; use super::support::{AI, HUMAN, act, close, register_cards, unit};`). Do not define a helper named `unit`, `det`, `ai_options`, `js` or `ids`: `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` refuses copies. Name no test `r<n>_…`.

7. **Prove the tests fail without the change.** After step 6 compiles, every assertion that uses `OFF` pins today's value. Check each against the issue's "today" numbers (10, 20, 0). If one differs, stop and report it rather than edit the expected value.

## Tests

All tests are in `crates/ai/tests/ai/static_attack_flags.rs`. Constants:
- `SCORCH = "stinkyscapeplus-037"`
- `TOXOPID = "stinkyscapeplus-121"`
- `VANILLA = "core-008"`, a 4/4
- `BIG = "core-025"`, a 7/7 with Armor 7
- `MENACE = "core-019"`, a 9/9 Taunt

Define:
- `const OFF: EvalWeights = EvalWeights { static_attack_flags_read: false, ..AI_EVAL };`
- `board(ai_health: i32, ai_field: Value, enemy_field: Value) -> GameState`, which calls `register_cards()` and `scenario(json!({"seed": "ai-static-flags", "p1": {"health": .., "field": ..}, "p2": {"field": ..}})).state().clone()`, as in `gauntlet.rs`. A unit is `{"def": .., "lane": n}`, plus `"radiant": true` or `"position": "DEF"` where noted. Scenarios keep the AI in p1 and use fewer than 20 instances.
- `wall(state)` and `walls(state)`, copied from `gauntlet.rs`: `ActionBody::SwitchPosition` of BIG, and `wall_switches(state, AI, &candidate_actions(state, AI, Prices::NONE))`.

1. `scorch_swings_at_no_hero_so_it_adds_no_face_threat`: for `(radiant, today)` in `[(false, 10), (true, 20)]`, with the AI at 30 life and an enemy Scorch in lane 3 and nothing across:
   - `face_threat(&s, HUMAN) == 0`
   - `face_threat_with(&s, HUMAN, &OFF) == today`
   - `face_threat_with(&s, HUMAN, &GREEDY_EVAL) == today`

   Also put the same Scorch on the AI's side and check `face_threat(&s, AI) == 0` and `face_threat_with(&s, AI, &OFF) == today`.
2. `scorch_costs_the_rest_of_the_board_nothing`: an enemy Scorch in lane 3 plus a Vanilla in lane 1 gives `face_threat == 4`, `OFF == 14` and `GREEDY_EVAL == 14`. Only Scorch's swings drop.
3. `a_lone_scorch_calls_for_no_wall`:
   - The AI is at 10 life with BIG in lane 3 in Attack Position, against an enemy Scorch in lane 3. `walls(&s)` is empty, and `face_threat_with(&s, HUMAN, &OFF) == 10`.
   - Control: the AI at 4 life, BIG in lane 1, an enemy Vanilla in lane 1 and a Scorch in lane 3. `face_threat == 4` and `walls(&s) == vec![wall(&s)]`, so a real threat still calls for a wall.
4. `toxopid_walks_past_a_defense_position_unit`: the AI has a Vanilla in lane 3 with `"position": "DEF"`, and an enemy Toxopid is in lane 3. For base and `"radiant": true` (10 and 20):
   - `face_threat(&s, HUMAN)` is 10 and 20
   - `OFF` is 0
   - `GREEDY_EVAL` is 0

   Repeat with the AI's Menace (a printed Taunt, Attack Position): 10 against `OFF` 0.
5. `a_taunt_still_walls_every_other_attacker`: the AI has a Menace; the enemy has a Toxopid in lane 3 and a Vanilla in lane 1. `face_threat == 10` (the Vanilla stays bound and lands nothing, Toxopid walks past) and `OFF == 0`. With the Vanilla alone against the Menace, both give 0.
6. `a_toxopid_makes_a_defense_switch_pointless`: the AI is at 10 life with BIG in lane 1 in Attack Position, against an enemy Toxopid. `face_threat(&s, HUMAN) == 10` and `walls(&s)` is empty. Let `walled = act(&s, AI, wall(&s))`: `face_threat(&walled, HUMAN) == 10` while `face_threat_with(&walled, HUMAN, &OFF) == 0`, which is why the old reading offered the switch.
7. `the_evaluation_drops_the_lethal_threat_and_pressure_these_flags_wall_off`, modelled on the last test of `gauntlet.rs`:
   - Enemy Scorch, AI at 10 life: `close(evaluate(&s, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL) - evaluate(&s, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &OFF), AI_EVAL.lethal_threat)`.
   - The AI's own Scorch in lane 3 against an empty enemy field with `"health": 10`: `close(evaluate(.., &OFF) - evaluate(.., &AI_EVAL), AI_EVAL.lethal_pressure)`.
8. `the_lethal_gap_reads_ignores_taunt_too`: the AI's Toxopid in lane 3, an enemy Menace in lane 1, `"p2": {"health": 15}`.
   - `let toxopid = unit(&s, AI, TOXOPID);` and `let attacks = [(toxopid, 10, true)];`
   - `damage_past_taunts_with(&s, HUMAN, &attacks, &AI_EVAL) == 10`, with `&OFF` giving 0, and `damage_past_taunts(&s, HUMAN, &attacks) == 10`
   - `ready_gap(&s, AI) == 5.0`

   If `ready_gap` is not 5.0, read `lethal.rs::ready_gap` for the reason (its early returns are `state.pending`, a non-Main phase or a seat that is not active) before changing anything.
9. `without_these_cards_the_threat_is_unchanged`: three boards with only Vanillas and BIG give `face_threat == face_threat_with(.., &OFF)` on both seats.
10. `greedy_eval_keeps_the_old_reading`: `const { assert!(AI_EVAL.static_attack_flags_read) };` and `const { assert!(!GREEDY_EVAL.static_attack_flags_read) };`.

Commands, in order:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai static_attack_flags`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai gauntlet` and `... brittle`, `... lethal_hint`, `... pierce`, `... cleave` and `... ranged_flying`, the neighbours of the changed code
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh gate`

## Done when

- [ ] `EvalWeights.static_attack_flags_read` exists, on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, with its doc comment.
- [ ] `face_threat_from` asks `attack_restriction` for a unit with `attacks_only_across`. The flag is read first and only behind `w.static_attack_flags_read`.
- [ ] `damage_past_taunts_with(.., w)` never binds a Taunt-ignorer to a Taunt when the flag is on, and `damage_past_taunts` keeps its signature and reads `AI_EVAL`.
- [ ] The acceptance numbers hold in tests: Scorch 0 (base and Radiant), `wall_switches` empty at 10 life, Toxopid facing one Defense unit 10, `GREEDY_EVAL` unchanged on each board.
- [ ] `crates/ai/README.md` paragraph added.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` passes, as do `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh gate`. Name any red check by its name in the report.
- [ ] The report records the decisions below.

## Risks

- **The frozen yardstick.** `GREEDY_EVAL` must stay off. Test 10 and every `GREEDY_EVAL` assertion above guard it. Do not add the flag anywhere the greedy baseline reads without its weights.
- **Weightless callers.** `ready_gap` (the lethal solver and `reply.rs`) and `tests/ai/lethal.rs:106` call `damage_past_taunts` and now read `AI_EVAL`'s flag. This matches the engine's rule, and it only changes boards holding a Taunt-ignorer. Scorch already counts nothing there, since `lethal.rs::may_hit_hero` uses `attack_restriction`.
- **The learned `face_threat` feature (`features.rs`).** Its value moves on boards with these cards, as in #3287. No fixture pins it. If a whole-crate test fails, read why before touching it, and never edit an expected number to match.
- **Purity and hidden information.** Both new reads (`flags_of`, `attack_restriction`) use only public board data, like the code beside them. No new clock, I/O, RNG or number, so rules 4 and 9 are untouched.
- **Where the full suite could show it.** `cargo jackioh gate` could show a strength change. If it fails, report the numbers instead of loosening a gate.
- **`classify`.** A `crates/ai/src` change classifies as AI with no card claim, so it needs no patch fragment.

Decisions to record in the report:
- One flag covers both readings. The alternative was two flags, rejected because the issue asks for one and they ship together.
- The `_with` split keeps `damage_past_taunts`'s public signature. The alternative was a weights parameter on it, rejected for the same reason R3793000 rejected one on `wall_switches`.
- The lethal read takes `AI_EVAL`'s flag. The alternative was leaving it on the old reading, rejected because the engine's rule is the same for the seat's own lethal.
- No new ruling. This adds no rule; R3550001 and R3560007 already make both. #3287 did the same for R1849005. Nothing is added to `spec/` or `spec/pending/`.

## Open questions

None. Left for later, as the issue says, since each needs a new engine board fact: Force Projector's and Oct's per-turn damage pool (R3550004) and Unan's lethal guard (R1204) are still not read by `face_threat`.
````
